children: rose 4.27% intraday after a run of announcements at its Fal.Con conference, starting with news that the Falcon platform now runs on Alphabet's

Google Cloud infrastructure in the US, with more regions planned. "Every enterprise has become a multi-cloud organization," said chief business officer Daniel Bernard. Running Falcon on regional infrastructure also addresses data sovereignty requirements, which has become a live constraint for customers moving AI workloads.
Falcon will also be available through Snowflake

Marketplace, and customers can apply pre-committed Snowflake capacity toward it under the Marketplace Capacity Drawdown program. Federated search will pull Snowflake data into Falcon investigations without moving it. That turns an existing data warehouse commitment into a procurement route for security software.
On the product side, CrowdStrike launched Falcon IQ, built on Nvidia

Nemotron open models and Charlotte AI AgentWorks, with more than 50 agents handling assessment, prioritization and remediation for partners. It also expanded Project QuiltWorks to ingest data from twelve vendors including Zscaler
and HackerOne into Falcon Next-Gen SIEM. CrowdStrike says in-pipeline filtering cuts storage costs by up to 50%.

title: CrowdStrike Stock Rises on Four Fal.Con Platform Announcements
